features.no_box: No complete boxed scalar integer in observed prefix
features.no_candidate: No complete scalar box and no explicit answer/result is/equals/: integer candidate in observed prefix
features.recent_correction: At least one correction phrase in last2048 characters: wait, mistake, incorrect, contradiction, recalculate, reconsider; case-insensitive whole words
features.suffix_repeat: Fraction of final253 token fourgrams that occur more than once anywhere in checkpoint prefix

selection: Leave-one-question-out. Train only on other29 questions, keep both seeds together. Maximize accuracy among rules with tokens AND replay time <=75% fixed8K, ties lowest tokens then name. If none feasible choose fixed4K fallback. Include fixed4K fallback in family. No threshold expansion.
comparators: Fixed4K and8K;10000 random assignments among eligible cells matching extension count; nonselective expected token/time-cost matched mixtures.
target: Retain80% of fixed4K->8K gain and save25% time AND tokens vs8K; selection value positive against both expected matched-cost mixtures. Practical pass is point-estimate feasibility, not proof.
limits: All2025 is development data; no GPU inference. No feature uses final answer phase,future tokens,reference,ID,seed,or manual semantic labels. Early thinking closure bypasses gate and retains4K outcome. Features are proxies, not mathematical-progress verification.
uncertainty: 5000 question-cluster resamples of stored OOF decisions; descriptive, no selector refitting in bootstrap.
